for: hpr1's move-48 TIMING_RISK evidence object (intent evidence key 'timing_risk')

identity_class_legs.what: list of file references (path/bytes/sha256) to COMPLETED t4_direct legs; >=1, no duplicate paths
each leg must: validate through validate_decode_wall_clock on its own runtime_dir/archive_path
share the candidate's prefire risk receiver digest
report the candidate's decoded_token_sha256 in its T4 cold report

source_t4_leg.what: the DOMINATING leg's file reference; must be one of identity_class_legs by exact reference equality
source_t4_leg.for move 48: move 46's leg (960,913 bits >= 951,228 and 180,001 B >= 179,111 B); move 44's leg also dominates and may be used instead

candidate_work_facts.what: exactly the five facts re-derived from the candidate's OWN cold n600 report (the log pinned by evidence.raw_identity_n600.candidate_public_stdout)
candidate_work_facts.gate re-derives: the report must name the candidate archive (sha + bytes) and the retained candidate raw sha

diagnostic_reference_receiver.path: the tree the candidate diagnostics ran on
diagnostic_reference_receiver.sha256: must equal the candidate receiver digest

receiver_delta_manifest.what: file ref to the COMPLETE normalized delta between the dominating leg's runtime and the candidate runtime
receiver_delta_manifest.must: carry every relative_path with source == candidate (ZERO differing rows) and both endpoint digests equal to the candidate receiver digest

base_local_diagnostic.what: file ref + {wall_seconds, authority: false} to a cold n600 local receipt
receipt must carry: runtime_dir whose risk digest equals the candidate's
archive_sha256 that is a declared class archive OR the pointer archive at intent
cold_start true, checkpoint_resume false, frames == list(range(600))

candidate_local_diagnostics.what: list (>=1) of the same shape, plus cold: true and n_samples: 600
candidate_local_diagnostics.extra requirement: receipt archive_sha256 == the candidate archive sha

arithmetic.local_cost_fraction_observed: max(0.0, max(candidate diagnostic wall) / base diagnostic wall - 1)

dry_run.note: the wrapper receipts under dry_move48/ are a ddm_pr19 rehearsal built from the arm's retained measurements; hpr1 emits its own diagnostic receipts and delta manifest — the gate re-derives the delta from the two trees, so only the CONTENT must match.
